d: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele is taking the lead in fighting against violent games in Haiti. Last week, a Gang Boss, Mathias Saintil, was killed in an anti-gang operation north of capital city Port-Au-Prince in the Cite Soleil slum. It is being reported that Saintil was killed using attack drones that blew up his vehicle, after which he was reportedly gunned down by government forces.
